advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Either post low_disk.exhausted_message() on the change at low-disk budget exhaustion, or delete the unused exhausted_message() and document that exhaustion is comment-less.
evidence: src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py:465-479 returns `decision, _low_disk_exhausted_result(...)` immediately after emitting REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED; the caller at voter.py:692 does `if deferred is not None: return deferred`, so no post_review is reached.
src/rebar/review_bot/low_disk.py:102 `def exhausted_message(attempts, max_attempts)` — search_files shows its only occurrence is its own definition (never called).
docs/review-policy.md:72-74 frames low-disk exhaustion as leaving labels unchanged but the change 'remains blocked' — with no comment, the author has no on-change breadcrumb.
advisory.finding: low_disk.exhausted_message() builds the operator-facing 'Automatic low-disk retry holdback exhausted' change comment, but the exhaustion path in voter._handle_retryable_gap returns _low_disk_exhausted_result early without posting any message to the change. When the low-disk retry budget is spent the change goes silently vote-less with no comment, so an operator/author sees no on-change signal that the review was terminally deferred for host disk pressure — the intended message is dead code.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Remove the unused low_disk.is_low_disk_decision / exhausted_status / exhausted_message and janitor.ensure_min_free_space, or wire them in and add coverage.
evidence: search_files for `is_low_disk_decision` returns only src/rebar/review_bot/low_disk.py:56 (its definition).
search_files for `exhausted_status` returns only low_disk.py:111.
search_files for `exhausted_message` returns only low_disk.py:102.
search_files for `ensure_min_free_space` returns only src/rebar/_snapshot/janitor.py:157.
advisory.finding: low_disk.py defines is_low_disk_decision(), exhausted_status(), and exhausted_message(), and janitor.py defines ensure_min_free_space(), but none of these are referenced anywhere in the repo — they are dead code added by this change.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Have _raise_snapshot_low_disk reuse the already-measured VolumeFreeSpace (thread it out of the has-room check) or guard its volume_free_space call so a probe race cannot escape as an uncaught OSError.
evidence: src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py:534-535 `if not _snapshot_store_has_room(store): _raise_snapshot_low_disk(store)`

src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py:486-489 `_raise_snapshot_low_disk` does `raise SnapshotLowDiskError(volume_free_space(root))` — volume_free_space calls shutil.disk_usage with no try/except (janitor.py:136-145).
Contrast janitor.py:151-154 and 160-163 which guard shutil.disk_usage with `except OSError`.
advisory.finding: _raise_snapshot_low_disk() calls volume_free_space(root) a second time (a fresh shutil.disk_usage) after _snapshot_store_has_room() already determined the volume is below floor; unlike has_min_free_space/ensure_min_free_space, this second disk_usage call is not wrapped in an OSError guard, so a transient stat failure between the two probes would raise an uncaught OSError out of materialize() instead of the intended SnapshotLowDiskError.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that makes produce_code_review_verdict RAISE SnapshotLowDiskError and asserts the adapter returns gap_reason=='low-disk' with the low_disk_path/free_bytes/min_bytes coverage details.
evidence: adapter.py:363-383 adds `except Exception as exc: ... if isinstance(exc, SnapshotLowDiskError): ... return _block("low-disk", {... "coverage": {"low_disk": True, "low_disk_path": str(space.path), "low_disk_free_bytes": space.free_bytes, "low_disk_min_bytes": space.min_free_bytes}})`
tests/unit/test_review_bot.py:2749 `_gap_verdict` returns a low-disk verdict DICT `{"low_disk": True, ...}` — the adapter reaches it via `_coverage_gap_reason`, not via a raised exception

search of tests/unit/test_review_bot.py for `raise` shows only `raise RuntimeError("LLM down")` (line 433) and GerritError injections; no test raises SnapshotLowDiskError through produce_code_review_verdict

Named violating input: monkeypatching produce_code_review_verdict to `raise SnapshotLowDiskError(VolumeFreeSpace(path=Path('/tmp'), free_bytes=1024, total_bytes=..., min_free_bytes=2048))` is the untested case the added lines handle
advisory.finding: The adapter's newly-added typed low-disk exception branch (maps a raised SnapshotLowDiskError to a low-disk coverage block with free/floor byte details) is never exercised: all low-disk tests inject a RETURNED verdict dict carrying {"low_disk": True} that routes through _coverage_gap_reason, so the isinstance(exc, SnapshotLowDiskError) path and its space.free_bytes/space.min_free_bytes extraction are untested. A regression that dropped or mis-typed this branch (falling through to the review-error _block) would not be caught.
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_review_bot.py, add a case where `_patch_verdict` is replaced by a stub that raises `SnapshotLowDiskError(volume_free_space(...))`; assert `code_review_decision(...)['gap_reason'] == 'low-disk'` and that the coverage detail keys are populated from the exception's space.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Assert REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED is emitted on low-disk budget exhaustion, alongside the existing VOTER_ERROR-absence check.
evidence: voter.py adds `_emit(logging.ERROR, "REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED", change_id=..., attempt=attempts, max_attempts=...)` on the spent low-disk budget path
review-policy.md diff: "exhausting its retry budget leaves labels unchanged and logs `REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED`"
search of tests for `REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED` returns (no matches)

test_low_disk_retry_budget_exhaustion_remains_voteless asserts `"VOTER_ERROR" not in capsys.readouterr().err` but no positive assertion on the low-disk marker (tests/unit/test_review_bot.py:2828-2832)
advisory.finding: The REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED log marker — the operator-facing signal that distinguishes a terminal low-disk no-vote from the VOTER_ERROR escalation (documented in ADR 0069 and review-bot-ops.md) — is emitted by the voter but asserted by no test. test_low_disk_retry_budget_exhaustion_remains_voteless only asserts VOTER_ERROR is ABSENT; it never asserts REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED is PRESENT.
advisory.suggested_fix: Capture logs (caplog/capsys) in test_low_disk_retry_budget_exhaustion_remains_voteless and assert `"REVIEW_LOW_DISK_DEFERRED_EXHAUSTED" in <captured>` in addition to the VOTER_ERROR-absence assertion.
